newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: U.S. journalist murdered in Kazakhstan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. journalist murdered in Kazakhstan.

text.p: A 28-year-old American journalist running a U.S. media charity in Central Asia was found murdered in his apartment in the Kazakh capital Almaty on Thursday, police said.

Staff at the Moscow office of Internews, a California-based non-profit organisation which provides technical and training support to independent media, confirmed the death of Chris Gehring, its director of Central Asian operations.
Chief detective Alibek Shapenov told Reuters in Almaty that the murder appeared to be the result of a burglary at the apartment.
Gehring, a native of Arkansas who majored in political science at Northwestern University, had lived in Almaty since May 1995. He had previously worked at ABC News in Moscow and CNN in Atlanta.
